report.summary: All four UI tests fail for one reason: the /books page handler calls list_books(), which sleeps a random 0-8 seconds (app/main.py:150). That regularly exceeds the 5-second Playwright timeout set in tests/ui/conftest.py, so the page.goto('/books') calls time out, and the register test's click times out while it waits for the redirect to /books to finish. Treat this as flaky, not a product bug. First, remove or bound the random delay in app/main.py (or make it deterministic and test-only) and rerun the UI suite.

causes.title: Random server-side delay in list_books exceeds the 5 s UI timeout
causes.explanation: list_books() in app/main.py sleeps for random.uniform(0, 8) seconds before querying the database. Every render of /books goes through it (books_page via render_books, and the POST /register redirect target). Whenever the sampled delay is above about 5 s, Playwright's default timeout (set to 5000 ms by the autouse fixture fail_fast in tests/ui/conftest.py:5-7) expires. The three books tests fail at page.goto('/books') in BooksPage.open (tests/support/pages.py:33-35). The register test passes its click, but the click then waits for the post-submit navigation to /books to finish and times out (tests/ui/test_login_ui.py:9 via pages.py:22). The outcome depends on random chance, so the same commit can pass on a rerun. test_deleted_book_disappears also opens /books and passed in this run, which fits a random-timing failure. The fact that the 5 s timeout is the limit, not the app being broken, is why this is not a product_bug.
evidence: app/main.py:149-150: def list_books(user_id: int) -> list[dict]: / time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8))
app/main.py:256: "books": list_books(user["id"]), (called from render_books, used by books_page at app/main.py:311-314)
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:10 / :23 / :39 call BooksPage(...).open(), which does self.page.goto("/books") (tests/support/pages.py:33-35)
Failure text: "Page.goto: Timeout 5000ms exceeded. Call log: - navigating to \"http://127.0.0.1:63061/books\", waiting until \"load\""

tests/ui/test_login_ui.py:9 register submit -> pages.py:22 get_by_test_id("submit").click(); call log ends with "waiting for scheduled navigations to finish" after the click action was done, which is consistent with the redirect to /books being slow
tests/ui/test_books_ui.py:31: test_deleted_book_disappears also opens /books but is not in the failed list (passed in this run)
causes.suggested_fix: Remove the artificial time.sleep(random.uniform(0, 8)) from list_books in app/main.py. If the delay is meant to simulate latency, make it a fixed, configurable value that is off by default (for example, from an env var set only for a dedicated slow-path test), so the UI tests never see it. As a secondary option, raise the UI timeout for navigations, but that only hides the problem since the delay can still reach 8 s. Then rerun the UI tests several times to confirm they are stable.
